notes: The assertion text says 8 parts but the enumerated list (U1, U2, C1-C4, L1, J1, J2) is 9 parts; all 9 are placed.

C4 has no net besides GND in the prompt; the agent assigned it to an assumed EN RC role and placed it accordingly, which is disclosed in the summary.
